sql: select e.key as experiment, e.state, v.version, ep.epoch_number, d.deployment_key, d.kind, d.started_at, d.ended_at, ar.arm_key, a.strategy_tag, (select count(*) from paper_trades pt where pt.strategy=a.strategy_tag and pt.created_at < d.started_at) as prior_paper_rows from experiment_deployments d join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id=d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id=ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id left join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.deployment_id=d.id left join experiment_arms ar on ar.id=a.arm_id where e.key='mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap' order by d.started_at, d.kind
